reason: Entry point for the Go CLI's zero-dependency, offline-testable backend contracts and the relevant guideline set.
Defines report/cmd cohesion, writer and function-value seams, terminal UI precedent, pure rendering, and the prohibition on unnecessary mutable globals.
Places width probing in report platform files and search orchestration in cmd while preserving dependency direction and platform-suffix conventions.
Requires zero third-party modules, GoDoc, deterministic unit tests, invalid-input/no-stdout coverage, cross-platform compilation, integration parity, and the full validation gate.
Protects stdout-only results and confirms that console-query fallback must not introduce diagnostic stdout or unnecessary warnings.
Directs reuse of the existing console.IsTerminal facility and searchLayout/Truncate primitives instead of duplicating platform or layout logic.
Guides the writer-to-platform-to-renderer contract and preservation of JSON, validation, and summary-footer boundaries.
